@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Daniel had not prepared for the final exam at all, so it was i______e that he would fail.
= inevitable
~詞義 inevitable（adj.）不可避免的
~原文 Daniel had not prepared for the final exam at all, so it was inevitable that he would fail.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The park became the perfect v______e for big events because it offered open space and easy transportation access.
= venue
~詞義 venue（n.）舉行地點
~原文 The park became the perfect venue for big events because it offered open space and easy transportation access.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The boys were playing catch when they accidentally s______hed the principal's car window.
= smashed
~詞義 smash（v.）打碎
~原文 The boys were playing catch when they accidentally smashed the principal's car window.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Though Ted was Sarah's f______r son, she loved him with all her heart.
= foster
~詞義 foster（adj.）收養的;代養的
~原文 Though Ted was Sarah's foster son, she loved him with all her heart.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: People find it difficult to work a______e Jimmy because he has a bad temper and no patience.
= alongside
~詞義 alongside（prep.）與…一起
~原文 People find it difficult to work alongside Jimmy because he has a bad temper and no patience.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Terry is an influential sports ______. Many sports fans like to read his articles.
A: columnist
B: deputy
C: missionary
D: verdict
= A
~詞義 columnist（n.）專欄作家
~原文 Terry is an influential sports columnist. Many sports fans like to read his articles.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The prime minister believes that with better ______, the country's economy will grow much faster.
A: commentary
B: endorsement
C: infrastructure
D: prejudice
= C
~詞義 infrastructure（n.）基礎建設
~原文 The prime minister believes that with better infrastructure, the country's economy will grow much faster.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The assassin ______ the knife deep into the man's back, and the man cried loudly for help.
A: combated
B: derived
C: snatched
D: thrust
= D
~詞義 thrust（v.）刺
~原文 The assassin thrust the knife deep into the man's back, and the man cried loudly for help.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The scientists are searching for a way to generate electricity that creates ______ pollution.
A: inherent
B: exterior
C: minimal
D: verbal
= C
~詞義 minimal（adj.）極小的
~原文 The scientists are searching for a way to generate electricity that creates minimal pollution.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Queen Elizabeth came to the ______ when she was twenty-five years old, and she is now the longest-reigning queen in English history.
A: fraction
B: premier
C: throne
D: slot
= C
~詞義 throne（n.）王座
~原文 Queen Elizabeth came to the throne when she was twenty-five years old, and she is now the longest-reigning queen in English history.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: crippled
B: deployed
C: slammed
D: inherent
E: vein
F: predator

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lion is the most fearful ______ in the African grasslands.
= F
~詞義 predator（n.）肉食性動物
~原文 The lion is the most fearful predator in the African grasslands.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The soldier was ______ during battle, yet he refused to let his injuries define the rest of his life.
= A
~詞義 cripple（v.）使受傷身障
~原文 The soldier was crippled during battle, yet he refused to let his injuries define the rest of his life.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: There is a(n) ______ risk of injury in any kind of sport.
= D
~詞義 inherent（adj.）固有的
~原文 There is a(n) inherent risk of injury in any kind of sport.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: After Allen had a fight with his wife, he ______ the door and left. He looked as if he were going to explode.
= C
~詞義 slam（v.）猛然關上
~原文 After Allen had a fight with his wife, he slammed the door and left. He looked as if he were going to explode.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tom was so angry that a(n) ______ stood out on his forehead.
= E
~詞義 vein（n.）靜脈
~原文 Tom was so angry that a(n) vein stood out on his forehead.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: ally
B: commitment
C: allocation
D: smog
E: premature
F: preliminary

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Parents are a teacher's closest ______ in the process of educating children.
= A
~詞義 ally（n.）盟友
~原文 Parents are a teacher's closest ally in the process of educating children.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The government announced a new ______ of funds for disaster relief, hoping to aid reconstruction efforts.
= C
~詞義 allocation（n.）分配
~原文 The government announced a new allocation of funds for disaster relief, hoping to aid reconstruction efforts.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The judges watched the ______ closely and chose contestants who showed strong skills and confidence.
= F
~詞義 preliminary（n.）預賽
~原文 The judges watched the preliminary closely and chose contestants who showed strong skills and confidence.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The badly polluted city is completely covered by ______. People have to wear masks and goggles when they go out.
= D
~詞義 smog（n.）霧霾
~原文 The badly polluted city is completely covered by smog. People have to wear masks and goggles when they go out.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Despite his ______ birth, the baby survived and grew up healthily.
= E
~詞義 premature（adj.）過早的
~原文 Despite his premature birth, the baby survived and grew up healthily.
